onboarding.s1_body: An end-to-end Clinical Study Report (CSR) workflow — from raw data to regulatory submission package, with AI throughout.
onboarding.s2_body: SAS / Excel / PDF / Word are all fine. The router classifies each file and dispatches the right worker.
onboarding.s3_body: The workbench proposes PII / coding fixes column-by-column; auto-analyze produces reusable StatBlocks.
onboarding.s4_body: The writer agent cites real stats and source text with full provenance. Switch to manual edit any time.
onboarding.s5_body: Multi-reviewer + sign chain + hallucination check; export DOCX / TLF / eCTD packages.
onboarding.s6_body: The "?" menu in the top bar can replay this tour or show shortcuts.
onboarding.s_demo_body: Oncology, rare disease, vaccine, pediatric, cardiovascular — one click on the project list creates an end-to-end demo with realistic fake ADaM data.

q1.a: Yes — MIT licensed at github.com/your-org/AutoCSR. Self-hosting and forks are encouraged.

q2.a: Local-first storage, multi-tenant isolation, audit chain and e-signatures. You can run fully air-gapped against a local LLM.

q3.a: Yes — point settings.yaml at a local LLM (vLLM / ollama) and no calls leave the machine.

q4.q: Which data formats do you support?
q4.a: SAS xpt/sas7bdat, Excel/CSV, PDF, Word; define.xml is parsed in reverse for ADaM metadata.

q5.q: Are you 21 CFR Part 11 / NMPA compliant?
q5.a: We ship audit trail, e-signature, sequential sign-chain and PII scanning. See docs/compliance.md. Final regulatory sign-off remains a RA responsibility.

q6.q: What if the AI writes something wrong?
q6.a: Every section runs hallucination_guard; you can switch to manual edit at any time and all versions are retained.

q7.a: Frontend ships zh / en / ja. Backend prompts switch on ProjectConfig.language.

q8.q: How do I export the final docx?
q8.a: Export page → pick template → tune fonts / header → generate. PDF / HTML / PPTX / Markdown-bundle / eCTD M5 zip are also supported.

q9.a: v2.4 fully supports < 768 viewport — three panes stack into tabs. Heavy authoring still works best on desktop.

q10.a: Please! See CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/contributing.md for template / agent / export / locale extension guides.
